newsitem.title: USA: Kintetsu USA opens intl customer service centre.
newsitem.headline: Kintetsu USA opens intl customer service centre.

text.p: Kintetsu World Express (USA) said it has created a customer service department, based in San Francisco, to focus on the needs of multinational accounts.

Kintetsu said in a statement that the new ICS department will focus on specialized services, information and reporting requirements needed by large accounts, freeing up local Kintetsu offices to concentrate on servicing those accounts from the operational standpoint.

The new department will be headed by Robert Banathy, who becomes assistant vice-president - western region. Banathy will be succeeded as terminal manager, national accounts, by San Diego terminal manager Tom Smith. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel +44 171 542 7706 Fax +44 171 542 5017
